guide.title: Leoric's Overview
guide.text:
Leoric is an aggressive melee Bruiser with strong self-sustain
and great mobility. He excels at dealing high damage through
powerful Basic Attacks and close-range abilities, while his survivability
allows him to stand his ground even if outnumbered by several enemies. After
taking lethal damage, Undying
causes him to turn into a Ghost
capable of moving freely and using abilities to slow enemies.
After a certain amount of time (influenced by how abilities are used while in
Ghost form), Leoric comes back to life at the current location of the Ghost.

guide.title: Leoric's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Good self-sustain
Solid waveclear
Decent mobility
Can deal percent-based damage
Fast respawn thanks to Drain Essence
Can become Unstoppable when needed
Strong in the late game
Weaknesses
Vulnerable to burst damage
Suffers against healing reduction effects
Weak in the early game

guide.title: Leoric's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Leoric synergizes with
Leoric pairs off really well with Heroes who can follow up
on his Entomb with a huge amount of burst damage
(for example Orphea using Eternal Feast and all her Basic Abilities)
or complementary crowd control
(such as Lurking Arm by Stukov).
Leoric is countered by
Leoric struggles against high-mobility Heroes
(such as Tracer) who can simply dodge Entomb
and/or disconnect his Drain Hope (like Samuro using
Mirror Image or Image Transmission).
Due to having self-healing in his kit, Leoric does not like to face Heroes who have access
to healing reduction Abilities (for example Biotic Grenade by Ana).

Leoric is a strong pick on Maps where the game lasts long enough to reach Level 20 and
unlock Buried Alive and/or where double soaking
is strong (notably Towers of Doom where you can count on both).
Additionally, Leoric is a good pick on Maps where your team requires a solid
Offlaner with good self-sustain and waveclear.

guide.title: Leoric's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Use Skeletal Swing to reduce the chance that Drain Hope will miss.
Drain Hope is particularly effective when used on enemy Heroes with high maximum Health and who lack mobility.
Wraith Walk allows you to walk through enemy Gates, but not through the permanent unpassable terrain that forms the Battleground.
When necessary, do not be afraid to trade your life for something else because you can respawn faster with Drain Essence, but remember you still give Experience for dying.
While in Ghost Form, use Ghastly Swing to reduce the chance that Drain Essence will miss.
Remember to Slow enemy Heroes and try to give vision to your team while you are in Ghost Form.
When respawning is dangerous, you can use your Hearthstone while in Ghost Form.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Leoric's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Leoric fulfills the role of an offensive Bruiser that
is only played as an Offlaner, especially on Maps
where double soaking is strong (for example Towers of Doom).
During team fights, he poses a constant threat to nearby enemies who lack mobility
because of Entomb being a powerful engage tool,
especially after picking Buried Alive at Level 20, a huge
power spike for any team composition featuring Leoric.

abilities.title: Leoric's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Use Skeletal Swing to reduce the chance that Drain Hope will miss.
Drain Hope is particularly effective when used on enemy Heroes with high maximum Health and who lack mobility.
Wraith Walk allows you to walk through enemy Gates, but not through the permanent unpassable terrain that forms the Battleground.
When necessary, do not be afraid to trade your life for something else because you can respawn faster with Drain Essence, but remember you still give Experience for dying.
While in Ghost Form, use Ghastly Swing to reduce the chance that Drain Essence will miss.
Remember to Slow enemy Heroes and try to give vision to your team while you are in Ghost Form.
When respawning is dangerous, you can use your Hearthstone while in Ghost Form.

abilities.title: Basic Attack
abilities.text:
Leoric has a special Basic Attack: the first two Basic Attacks cleave for 100% damage,
the third Basic Attack deals 225% damage to a single target. If you keep that in mind
when clearing Minions and watch the dedicated tracker in the bottom-left corner,
you can increase your waveclear and thus be able to
join your team quicker than usual.

abilities.title: Skeletal Swing
abilities.text:
Skeletal Swing
(Q)
Leoric
Mana: 70
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Leoric swings his mace, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage and Slowing enemies by 40% for 2.5 seconds. If an enemy Hero is hit, refund 50% of the cooldown and Mana cost. Deals 75% additional damage to Minions. Peasants!
Skeletal Swing is a Basic Ability that provides Leoric with a reliable source of
waveclear thanks to the bonus damage against Minions
and also assists him at landing his Drain Hope
more easily by Slowing enemy Heroes.
Hitting enemy Heroes with Skeletal Swing
will heavily reduce its cooldown and refund half of the Mana cost.
Considering so, you should try to hit the enemy Offlaner
while using Skeletal Swing to clear enemy Minions.

abilities.title: Drain Hope
abilities.text:
Drain Hope
(W)
Leoric
Mana: 60
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Grab an enemy Hero's soul, dealing up to 20% of their maximum Health as damage and healing Leoric for up to 20% of his maximum Health while he is nearby, over 3 seconds. Leoric's Movement Speed is reduced by 20% while this is active.
Drain Hope is a Basic Ability that gives Leoric self-sustain
while dealing percent-based damage at the same time.
Use it carefully and efficiently in order to grant as much healing as possible.
Landing this Ability is important while dueling in the
solo lane or during team fights. If you miss,
you lose your only source of self-sustain and lower your damage output as well.
To increase the chance it will connect, use Skeletal Swing
to Slow an enemy Hero and then cast Drain Hope
within 2.5 seconds, before the Slow fades away.
If you choose the wrong target, you lose part or all your self-sustain.
Do not cast Drain Hope on enemy Heroes who can easily
outrange it with mobility, unless you are certain they
cannot use such Abilities for a few seconds because of cooldowns or even
crowd control.
While the best target for Drain Hope is situational,
you should try to use it on enemy Heroes who have high maximum Health in order
to deal more damage; however, you will not get more healing based on that.

abilities.title: Wraith Walk
abilities.text:
Wraith Walk
(E)
Leoric
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 14 seconds
Leoric separates from his body, becoming Unstoppable and gaining Movement Speed accelerating up to 50% over 2.5 seconds. When Wraith Walk ends or is canceled, his body jumps to his wraith.
Wraith Walk is a Basic Ability that provides Leoric with
great mobility and a bit of survivability.
Use it as a gap closer to catch up to fleeing enemy Heroes,
to escape from danger when needed, or to dodge crowd control
effects thanks to the Unstoppable buff it provides.

abilities.title: Entomb
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Entomb
(R)
Leoric
Heroic
Mana: 90
Cooldown: 50 seconds
Create an unpassable tomb for 4 seconds.
Entomb is a Heroic Ability that creates unpassable terrain
that can be used as a form of indirect crowd control
because it works on Unstoppable enemy Heroes as well.
While the Heroic Ability itself is easy to understand in terms of
what it does, it requires you to know exactly when to use it and what target to
use it on. Do not use Entomb on enemy Heroes that have access to an Ability that
allows them to exit from it, unless they wasted that cooldown.
Before casting Entomb, make sure
to take a brief look on the Minimap and determine whether your team is nearby
and ready to follow up on the imprisoned enemy Heroes.
As soon as you cast Entomb, Leoric blocks its entrance. Sometimes you will have to decide
if you want to prevent the enemy Heroes from escaping—recommended if your team has enough
ranged Heroes to kill the encased Heroes from the distance—or allow allied Heroes
to enter—required if most of the damage done by your team comes from melee Heroes.

abilities.title: March of the Black King
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
March of the Black King
(R)
Leoric
Heroic
Mana: 75
Cooldown: 50 seconds
Leoric becomes Unstoppable and walks forward, swinging his mace 3 times. Enemies hit take 250 (+4% per level) damage, and Heroes hit heal Leoric for 12% of his maximum Health.
March of the Black King is a Heroic Ability that combines raw damage
with great self-sustain. Each swing damages nearby enemies in a large area in front of him
and a small area behind him. During its animation, Leoric is Unstoppable.
The major drawback of this Ability is the fact that it causes
Leoric to walk towards the starting direction without the possibility to change it,
so you should aim very carefully before casting March of the Black King
in order to avoid finding yourself in an unfavorable
position at the end of its duration.

abilities.title: Undying
abilities.text:
Undying
(D)
Leoric
Passive
Leoric becomes a ghost when he dies, and resurrects upon reaching full Health. Leoric deals no damage while dead.
Wrath Of The Bone King
Leoric's first two Basic Attacks cleave for 100% damage, and his third Basic Attack deals 225% damage to a single target.
Undying is a very unique Trait which allows Leoric to have an impact on
events even after dying.
While in Ghost Form, Leoric can only move and use two Abilities:
Ghastly Swing to Slow enemies and
Drain Essence to respawn faster.
Another important aspect of Undying is the fact that it provides vision
to your team, as you can freely move around the battlefield in order
to scout the position of every enemy Hero around you without them being able to kill you.
Keep in mind, however, that Leoric will
materialize at his current location once his Health is fully recovered.
Thus, when dying as Leoric, it is important to constantly check your Health while in Ghost Form
in order to avoid respawning in the middle of the enemy team.
Leoric will not be able to use his Mount while dead.
In case the enemy team is ready to kill you after respawning, you can use
Hearthstone [B] while in Ghost Form to teleport in the Hall of Storms.
It is important to know that resurrecting will automatically stop its 6-second channel,
therefore you can only use this trick when Leoric needs more than 6 seconds to respawn.

abilities.title: Ghastly Swing
abilities.text:
Ghastly Swing
(Q)
Leoric
Cooldown: 8 seconds
Slow enemies by 40% for 2.5 seconds.
Ghastly Swing is a special Basic Ability
similar to Skeletal Swing that Leoric is able to use while
in Ghost Form.
Although it does not deal any damage to your enemies, the Slow
provided is still very useful to influence a team fight. Use this Ability as often as possible
to help your team reach enemy Heroes or to run away from them, but also to increase the chance
that Drain Essence will hit your desired enemy Hero.

abilities.title: Drain Essence
abilities.text:
Drain Essence
(W)
Leoric
Cooldown: 9 seconds
Throw out a chain, attaching to the first enemy Hero hit, healing Leoric for up to 10% of his maximum Health over 4 seconds as long as the enemy remains close.
Drain Essence is another special Basic Ability
similar to Drain Hope that Leoric is able to use while
in Ghost Form.
If you hit an enemy Hero with this Ability, Leoric gains Health
as long as the target remains in range or the effect ends after a few seconds.
As a consequence, this Ability is crucial to accelerate Leoric's resurrection process.
We recommend using Drain Essence as frequently as possible,
but do not rush because it is important that it connects on an enemy Hero.

Leoric becomes Unstoppable and walks forward, swinging his mace 3 times. Enemies hit take 250 (+4% per level) damage, and Heroes hit heal Leoric for 12% of his maximum Health.
March of the Black King is a situational Heroic Ability
that increases Leoric's survivability and damage, other than
making him Unstoppable for the duration.
You may need this Heroic Ability when your team does not have
enough burst damage as follow-up
for Entomb, when you desperately need to increase
the damage output of your team, or when you feel the urgency of extra healing
to keep yourself in a good shape during prolonged team fights.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Leoric
talent_pages.text:
?
Unyielding Despair
(Level 13)
Leoric
Drain Hope's cooldown is reduced by 0.75 seconds for every 1 second it is active. If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, its cooldown is reduced by an additional 2 seconds.
Unyielding Despair is a good Talent that allows
Leoric to use Drain Hope more often, especially if
the target enemy Hero does not break the connection too early.
Unyielding Despair requires either Drain Momentum or
Hopelessness at Level 7, Talents that help with the
aforementioned weakness.
?
Ominous Wraith
(Level 13)
Leoric
Increase Wraith Walk's duration by 100%. Enemy Heroes that come in contact with the wraith deal 50% less damage for 4 seconds.
Ominous Wraith is a good Talent that makes
Wraith Walk reduce the damage done by enemy Heroes hit
by its trail, especially useful on Heroes that can deal a lot of damage. Remember that
damage reduction effects work on Unstoppable
enemy Heroes as well (for example Deathwing). When going for Ominous Wraith,
pick Royal Focus at Level 16 for the cooldown reduction.
✔
Spectral Leech
(Level 13)
Leoric
Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage to the primary target damage equal 2.5% of the Hero's maximum Health and heal Leoric for 200% of the bonus damage dealt.
Spectral Leech is a strong Talent that empowers
Leoric's Basic Attacks with a leech effect. In particular, Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes
will deal percent-based damage and heal Leoric for twice that amount.
Spectral Leech has good synergy with Mithril Mace at Level 16,
unless you want Crushing Hope at the same Tier
to increase your burst damage.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Leoric
talent_pages.text:
?
Crushing Hope
(Level 16)
Leoric
If Drain Hope lasts its full duration, it instantly deals an additional 15% of the target's maximum Health as damage. This damage does not heal Leoric.
Crushing Hope is a good Talent that increases
Leoric's percent-based damage even more,
something that may be useful against enemy Heroes having high maximum Health
and no mobility at all (such as Azmodan).
Crushing Hope requires either Drain Momentum or
Hopelessness at Level 7, else the enemy Hero
will just get out of range before Drain Hope ends
and this Talent will not trigger.
?
Royal Focus
(Level 16)
Leoric
Wraith Walk increases the damage of the next Skeletal Swing within 5 seconds by 50%. Each enemy Hero hit by Skeletal Swing reduces the cooldown of Wraith Walk by 7 seconds.
Royal Focus is a good Talent that increases Leoric's
damage by a fair amount and reduces the cooldown of Wraith Walk
by 7 seconds for each enemy Hero hit by Skeletal Swing,
a powerful boost to Ominous Wraith at Level 13.
✔
Mithril Mace
(Level 16)
Leoric
Increase Leoric's Attack Speed by 20%.
Repeatable Quest: Nearby enemy Minion deaths grant 0.3% permanent Attack Speed, and Takedowns grant 3% permanent Attack Speed, up to 30%.
Mithril Mace is a strong Quest-based Talent that increases
Leoric's Attack Speed by 20% when picked, up to 50% after killing enough Minions and/or Heroes.
Mithril Mace has good synergy with Spectral Leech at Level 13:
the increased percent-based damage and self-healing can
cause severe issues for enemy Heroes with high maximum Health (for example Stitches).

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Leoric
talent_pages.text:
✔
Buried Alive
(Level 20)
Leoric
The duration of Entomb is lowered by 1 second, but enemies trapped inside are Silenced and take 50 (+4% per level) damage every 1 second.
Buried Alive is a strong Talent that turns Entomb
into an even more scary engage tool thanks to the
Silence effect it provides to the already impactful
unpassable terrain. Consequently, it is an excellent choice against Heroes
with mobility or defensive Abilities because
they are completely defenseless when caught by Entomb. The additional damage
is nice to have, but this Talent is already powerful without it.
?
Death March
(Level 20)
Leoric
The final swing of March of the Black King also applies Drain Hope to nearby enemy Heroes.
Death March is a good Talent that makes the last swing
of March of the Black King apply Drain Hope
to all nearby enemy Heroes. Keep in mind that any instance of Drain Hope applied by Death March will be
empowered by Talents as well.
Assuming you do not need Buried Alive,
you should prefer going for Burning Despair
over Death March because it gives similar damage
but constant Armor rather than delayed healing
and it works even when your Heroic Ability is on cooldown.
?
Burning Despair
(Level 20)
Leoric
Deal 40 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.
While Drain Hope is active, gain 40 Armor and the damage and area is increased by 100%.
Burning Despair is a strong Talent that offers
a significant amount of extra damage and survivability. While it passively deals
damage around Leoric, the damage and the area covered
are doubled while Drain Hope is active on an enemy Hero.
The survivability boost only comes when Drain Hope
is being channeled, in the form of bonus Armor,
which you will be able to keep constantly active thanks to Unyielding Despair at Level 13.
Burning Despair has good synergy with either Drain Momentum or
Hopelessness at Level 7 because they help Leoric to
keep the enemy Hero affected by Drain Hope in range for more time.
?
Shroud of the Dead King
(Level 20)
Leoric
Cooldown: 25 seconds
Activate to become Protected for 3 seconds, preventing all damage.
Shroud of the Dead King is a decent Talent that, when manually activated,
makes Leoric unkillable for 3 seconds, a powerful tool against burst damage.
All that said, you should rarely pick this Talent because
the alternatives will be more valuable most if not all the time.
